notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content: Added LegendMode enum {Off,Compact,Full} (app.rs), default Compact per issue #26. Added PlotLayer.legend_group: &'static str (data.rs) and LayerId::legend_group() (layers.rs) mapping each of the 16 layers to one of 6 buckets, collapsing exactly the families the issue names as its own example ('Isotherms / Quality lines / Saturation dome / Validation points') plus Isobars, Critical & triple point, and Region boundaries for completeness -- the 3 saturation-envelope layers and all 7 reference-data layers each collapse to one bucket since they already share a colour (INK / their own PALETTE entry respectively). Wired into app.rs plot_panel(): Off skips .legend() entirely; Compact renames every series to its legend_group before handing it to Line::new/Points::new so egui_plot's default LegendGrouping::ByName merges same-named entries into one row; Full keeps each layer's own distinct label (unchanged prior behaviour). Sidebar gets a new 'Legend' section with the same selectable_value row pattern as Theme. Added layers::legend_groups_collapse_the_families_issue_26_names test (asserts the saturation/reference collapses + that every built PlotLayer.legend_group matches LayerId::legend_group). Note: the SEPARATE exported-figure legend (figure/layout.rs LegendLayout) is untouched -- it already auto-columns and truncates reasonably and was out of this bead's scope (issue's legend complaints are about the live GUI). Verified: cargo check clean, cargo test --release --example tampines-steam-tables-gui: 27 passed, 0 failed.

title: GUI: legend modes (Off/Compact/Full, default Compact) with grouped auxiliary curves
